Perfect! The `--category` option is now working correctly. The tool:

- Filters orders to only include products in the specified category when `--category NAME` is provided
- Still processes all orders when no category is specified
- Ends with the summary line showing the count of filtered orders and total revenue

The example command `python3 -m tools.report data/orders.csv --category toys` correctly shows 300 toy orders with revenue 104343,11 EUR, and it ends with the summary line as required.
